what_this_is: The Workshop rows for TidyCal (tidycal.com), the booking service behind a person's booking pages. Each row is one http call to TidyCal's API, with the person's TidyCal key from the vault (tidycal-api-token) placed as a bearer header on tidycal.com only. Reads list booking types (which carry each booking page's address) and bookings; the write rows create and cancel one booking.

payload.label: List my TidyCal booking types
payload.job: List the booking types (event types) on my TidyCal account, each with its id, title, duration and public booking address
payload.description: Reads the booking types of the person's TidyCal account with their own key from the vault. Reads only; books nothing.

payload.label: List my TidyCal bookings
payload.job: List the bookings on my TidyCal account, with each booker's name and email, start and end, cancellation and meeting link
payload.description: Reads the person's TidyCal bookings with their own key from the vault, newest first. Reads only; changes nothing.
